Mia and Tom are in the same class. The school library is my favorite place. After school, we play together. He failed the driving test twice.
Mia's favorite subject is history. I like my life very much. We often go to the bookstore together. In fact, learn ten words a day.
Mia's favorite season is summer. The reading room is big and clean. My friend Tom is very kind.
